3 Researchers designed an investigation to find the effect of increasing levels of exercise on two
groups of people.
The first group of people were trained cyclists and the second group were untrained cyclists.
The researchers asked all the people to cycle at four levels of effort: 30%, 45%, 60% and 75% of
their maximum cycle speed.
They cycled for eight minutes at each level of effort.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:

Explain this prediction.

4 Water moves into plants from the soil and exits through the leaves.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain how water moves from the soil into the root.

Water reaches the leaves from the roots through the xylem. Fig. 4.1 shows images of stomata
on the lower surfaces of leaves of two varieties of olive plant, A and B. Both are shown at the
same magnification.
A B
Fig. 4.1

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Describe the function of stomata.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Compare the density of stomata between the two varieties of olive plant, A and B, shown
in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Under identical environmental conditions the rate of water uptake in plant A is higher
than plant B.
Explain why.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The density of stomata is an example of a leaf adaptation to the environmental conditions.
State two other adaptations of leaves for survival in a dry environment.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Water lost from the leaves enters the atmosphere.
Describe how water is recycled from the atmosphere back to the roots.

5 Plastic bags cause many problems in the environment.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Plastic bags were banned in Bangladesh in 2002.
Outline the effects of non-biodegradable plastics on the environment.

Some countries have not banned plastic bags. There have been many studies to analyse
possible alternatives to plastic bags.

plastic bags and paper bags.
